research_question: How concentrated were bilateral imports of electronic integrated circuits in 2022, which partner economies dominated importer exposure, and how does product-trade concentration compare descriptively with the broader ICIO production-dependency evidence?

source.provider: United Nations Statistics Division, UN Comtrade
source.secondary_flow: exports to World for exporter-scale diagnostics
source.revision_policy: UN Comtrade maintains a single current version and may revise annual data. Every evidence artifact must therefore record retrieval UTC time, data-availability metadata, publication metadata when returned, query parameters and a SHA-256 digest of the normalized raw response.
source.access_policy: Use official UN Comtrade API endpoints only. Never substitute mirrors or scraped trade websites. A subscription key may be supplied through CI secrets but must never be committed or logged.

scope.primary_product_scope: HS heading 8542 at four digits, because the case study was prospectively scoped to HS 8542 and the primary analysis is cross-sectional rather than a long time series.
scope.parts_note: Heading 8542 includes parts of electronic integrated circuits (for example HS 2017 code 854290). The primary heading-level estimand therefore covers the complete 8542 trade heading, not devices-only semiconductor fabrication output.
scope.six_digit_gate: Run the secondary breakdown only after returned classification metadata and code coverage are audited. Do not force a six-digit decomposition across incompatible reported classifications.
scope.time_scope: 2022 only for the confirmatory case study. No trend claims are allowed without a separate concordance-aware temporal design.

reporter_universe.construction: Query UN Comtrade data availability for 2022 annual HS final data, then retain reporters with positive HS 8542 import value returned by the official API.
reporter_universe.freeze: The exact reporter code/name set and data-availability metadata are written to the first evidence artifact before substantive concentration results are interpreted.
reporter_universe.icio_intersection: Create a separate matched subset for economies that can be mapped explicitly to the OECD ICIO country geography. Never drop non-ICIO reporters from the trade-only global analysis merely to increase cross-dataset agreement.

bilateral_panel.unit: reporter-importer x partner-exporter for 2022 HS 8542 imports
bilateral_panel.primary_value: primaryValue/tradeValue in current USD as returned by UN Comtrade
bilateral_panel.quantity_policy: net weight and supplementary quantity are diagnostics only because coverage and quantity units may differ; they are never substituted for trade value when missing.
bilateral_panel.world_partner: World aggregate rows are retained only for denominator/reconciliation diagnostics and are not treated as bilateral suppliers.
bilateral_panel.special_partners: Non-country or residual partner categories are preserved and explicitly flagged. They contribute to an all-reported-partner concentration measure but are excluded from named-country rankings. Their value share is reported separately.
bilateral_panel.duplicates: Reject duplicate reporter-period-flow-commodity-partner keys after applying the frozen aggregation level unless metadata explain a required additional dimension; do not silently sum unexplained duplicates.

primary_importer_metrics.total_import_value: sum of bilateral HS 8542 import value over all non-World partner categories
primary_importer_metrics.partner_share: bilateral import value divided by reporter total bilateral HS 8542 import value
primary_importer_metrics.partner_hhi_all_reported: sum of squared partner shares over all non-World partner categories
primary_importer_metrics.top3_partner_share: sum of the three largest partner shares
primary_importer_metrics.named_country_hhi: HHI renormalized over named-country partners only
primary_importer_metrics.residual_partner_share: share attributed to non-country/residual partner categories
primary_importer_metrics.world_reconciliation_ratio: bilateral non-World total divided by the returned World aggregate when both are positive; report rather than repair discrepancies

primary_rankings: largest importer totals by HS 8542 import value
highest material importer concentration by all-reported-partner HHI
largest named bilateral dependencies by importer partner share
largest named bilateral dependencies by trade value

materiality_rules.importer_concentration_ranking: restrict to reporters with total HS 8542 imports at or above the median positive importer total
materiality_rules.bilateral_share_ranking: require reporter total HS 8542 imports at or above the same frozen materiality threshold
materiality_rules.threshold_freeze: materiality threshold is computed once from the unfiltered positive 2022 reporter universe and written to evidence before rankings are interpreted

exporter_scale_diagnostics.source: reporter-reported 2022 exports of HS 8542 to World
metrics: share of total reported World exports across positive reporters
number of material importers for which the exporter is the largest named partner
number of material importers for which the exporter supplies at least 10%, 25% and 50% of HS 8542 imports
exporter_scale_diagnostics.boundary: Do not sum mirrored importer and exporter reports into one flow estimate and do not average them.

mirror_quality_audit.scope: top 50 named bilateral import links by value from the frozen primary importer panel
mirror_quality_audit.comparison: compare importer-reported imports with the corresponding exporter-reported exports when both observations exist
metrics: relative difference using max(import, export) denominator
signed log ratio when both values are positive
mirror_quality_audit.interpretation: mirror asymmetry is a data-quality/valuation/timing diagnostic, not a reason to overwrite the importer-reported primary value

secondary_product_breakdown.outputs: repeat importer concentration summaries by six-digit category only if the six-digit gate passes
secondary_product_breakdown.no_posthoc_scope_change: Do not drop 854290 from the primary 8542 heading after seeing results. A devices-only subtotal may be reported only as an explicitly secondary decomposition.

icio_comparison.icio_activity: C26, computer, electronic and optical products
icio_comparison.trade_measure: country HS 8542 export share and/or foreign-supplier importance from the trade panel
icio_comparison.icio_measure: country-aggregated C26 foreign intermediate sales/downstream dependence from the already validated 2022 ICIO evidence
icio_comparison.forbidden_interpretation: HS 8542 bilateral trade is not treated as technological input dependence, and ICIO C26 is broader than semiconductors. Agreement or disagreement is descriptive, not validation of one dataset by the other.

sensitivity.reporter_coverage: repeat concentration summaries on the ICIO-matched reporter subset
sensitivity.residual_partners: compare all-reported-partner HHI with named-country HHI and report residual-partner shares
sensitivity.parts: if the six-digit gate passes, compare full 8542 with devices-only 854231+854232+854233+854239
sensitivity.mirror_asymmetry: flag but do not exclude high-asymmetry links in the primary analysis; provide a sensitivity table for top links

scientific_boundaries: Trade value is not technological dependence.
Trade routing and re-exports can make a partner commercially important without identifying fabrication origin.
The 2022 cross-section does not support causal or dynamic resilience claims.
UN Comtrade revisions are not historically versioned, so retrieval metadata are part of the evidence contract.
No composite semiconductor vulnerability score will be invented after results are inspected.
No country, partner, or product subheading may be selected or excluded because its result is convenient.
